question: Find the value of 72 ÷ (9 – 7) of 3 - 6 × 2 + 8.
solution:
**Given Expression:**

72 ÷ (9 – 7) of 3 - 6 × 2 + 8

**Calculations:**

⇒ Calculate inside the parentheses: 9 - 7 = 2

⇒ Substituting back: 72 ÷ 2 of 3 - 6 × 2 + 8

⇒ Interpret "of" as multiplication: 72 ÷ 6 - 6 × 2 + 8

⇒ Now Division will be performed: 12 - 6 × 2 + 8

⇒ Now we will multiply: 12 - 12 + 8

⇒ Now we get, 8

**∴ The value of the expression is 8.**
